name: Lost Tunnel Routes

start.dialog: Lost my tunnel maps! Three generations of digging routes! Last time I had 'em was near the collapsed shaft west of here. Find 'em and I'll share something REAL valuable - the location of the Crystal Caverns!
start.objective: Search the collapsed shaft west of the bazaar for lost tunnel maps

progress.dialog: Those maps show EVERYTHING! Secret passages, mineral veins, dangerous zones! I NEED 'em back!
progress.objective: Continue searching the collapsed shaft area

complete.dialog: MAPS! You FOUND 'em! Look at these routes - beautiful! Here's the key to the Crystal Caverns. Rare gems there, but watch out for tunnel crawlers!

party_comments.kade: Underground routes could be useful for avoiding patrols.
party_comments.grit: Three generations of mining knowledge. That's valuable.
party_comments.nix7: Maps likely to contain geological instability data.

hidden_outcome: The maps contain a hidden route to a Progenitor cache that Dan never noticed - marked with a strange symbol
